ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Medicaid Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the reasoning behind the Trump administration's decision to freeze Medicaid funding in Minnesota and its potential impact on other states.
questions: What is the reasoning behind the Trump administration's decision to freeze Medicaid funding in Minnesota?
How will this decision impact mental health services in Minnesota and other states?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger issue with the administration's handling of Medicaid funds. By following the money and examining public records, we may be able to determine the motivations behind this decision and its potential consequences.
